title: ExpertCrowd-SWE: Measuring Frontier Coding Agents on Expert-Authored Engineering Tasks in Unfamiliar Codebases
abstract: arXiv:2611.13246v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: ExpertCrowd-SWE (EC-SWE) is a benchmark of 100 expert-authored, multi-file software engineering tasks for evaluating autonomous coding agents in large, unfamiliar codebases. Each task is a change request written by a practising engineer against a pinned commit of a real repository, paired with a sealed reference solution and a task-specific grader whose weighted, mostly executable criteria award partial credit; must-pass blockers and pass/fail gates encode what a maintainer would refuse to merge. The tasks span 87 open-source projects and 11 languages. The median ticket is 148 words, while the median reference solution changes 471 lines. Every task image is calibrated before release so that the reference solution scores 1.0 and both the untouched repository and an inert change score 0; nearly half of the tasks also ship alternative, lazy and adversarial control patches that the grader must classify correctly. translated_title: ExpertCrowd-SWE：在不熟悉的代码库中用专家编写的工程任务衡量前沿编程智能体
translated_abstract: ExpertCrowd-SWE（EC-SWE）是一个包含100个由专家编写、涉及多文件修改的软件工程任务基准，用于在大型且陌生的代码库中评估自主编程智能体。每个任务都是由一线工程师针对真实仓库某个固定提交撰写的变更请求，并配有密封的参考解决方案和一个任务专用的评分器；该评分器采用加权的、大多可执行的评分标准并给予部分得分，其中必须通过的阻断项和通过/失败门槛编码了维护者会拒绝合并的内容。这些任务覆盖87个开源项目和11种编程语言，任务工单的中位长度为148个单词，参考解决方案的中位改动量为471行。每个任务镜像在发布前都经过校准，以确保参考解决方案得分为1.0，而未修改的仓库和惰性变更的得分均为0；近一半的任务还附带替代性、偷懒和对抗性控制补丁，评分器必须能正确区分它们。最终的100个任务是从更大的候选池中筛选得出的。
tldr: EC-SWE是一个包含100个由专家编写、覆盖87个开源项目和11种语言的多文件软件工程任务基准，通过密封参考方案、可执行加权评分和对抗性对照补丁，在大型陌生代码库中严格评估自主编程智能体的真实工程能力。
en_tdlr: EC-SWE is a benchmark of 100 expert-authored, multi-file software engineering tasks spanning 87 open-source projects and 11 languages, rigorously evaluating autonomous coding agents in large, unfamiliar codebases through sealed reference solutions, weighted executable graders, and adversarial control patches.
